project_info.theme: Two number-10 football stars entering the stage together
project_info.color_palette: White, black, Viettel red, pitch green, Argentina sky blue, multicolor ribbon

main_subject.detail: Two football players are seen from behind walking out from a tunnel into a bright stadium. The left player wears an England number 10 jersey labeled 'ENGLAND 10'; the right player wears an Argentina number 10 jersey labeled 'ARGENTINA 10'. The top headline says 'KHI HAI SỐ 10 CHUNG MỘT SÂN KHẤU'. A small capsule line says 'ANH vs ARGENTINA | 2:00'. The bottom CTA says 'SOẠN DK CUP gửi 1331' and 'Chỉ 2.000/ngày để xem World Cup trên TV360'.
main_subject.style: Photoreal cinematic sports promo poster with heroic back-view composition

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a TV360 football match promo featuring two number-10 stars entering the field together. Centerpiece is a photoreal back-view shot of an England number 10 player and an Argentina number 10 player walking side by side from a stadium tunnel into bright daylight. Include the exact visible text 'KHI HAI SỐ 10 CHUNG MỘT SÂN KHẤU', 'ANH vs ARGENTINA | 2:00', 'SOẠN DK CUP gửi 1331', and 'Chỉ 2.000/ngày để xem World Cup trên TV360'. Background is a packed stadium bowl with a bright field opening at the end of the tunnel. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo in the top right, multicolor ribbon sweeping from the left across the lower frame, and a bold red CTA bar at the bottom. Technical style: photoreal cinematic sports advertising composite, heroic stadium daylight, bright backlight and subtle rim light, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This image depends on the tunnel-to-stadium reveal and the symmetry of the two players seen from behind. Keep the top headline large and airy, and do not replace the back-view with face portraits.
